summary: Breaking: existing databases must be recreated. All 78 SDK migrations are squashed into migrations/changes-0001-baseline.sql; a database built from the old migrations is refused by migrate up and at startup with application.SquashedHistoryError and has to be recreated (export the data first, recreate the database, migrate up, load the data back): there is no in-place upgrade. A new database gets the same schema as a replay of the 78 files (TestSquashedBaselineMatchesHistory). Rollback(ctx, n) refuses to reach the baseline; only RollbackAll runs its down, which drops its schemas with RESTRICT. Baselines are declared with -- +squashes <id> header lines; scripts/migrations-baseline.py builds one from pg_dump. Tests: ITF harnesses clone each database from a migrated template per migration hash and database role (itf_auto_tpl_<hash>, built under a cluster-wide advisory lock, database-level settings copied to each clone); ITF_AUTO_TEMPLATE=0 restores the replay. See docs/content/changelog.mdx.
